subject: Security & Ops handoff — ApexCloud review and scheduling
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alice Brown <alice.brown@apexcloud.com>
Cc: alex.martinez@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Security & Ops handoff — ApexCloud review and scheduling

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call last week. Per our conversation, the next step is a focused security & ops session (your security engineering + our security/compliance + SE) to run through data flow, retention, access controls, and the SOC2 evidence baseline. I want to make scheduling as simple as possible — below are a few windows we have open: 

- Tue Aug 11: 09:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Aug 12: 09:00–12:00 PT (preferred for SE availability)
- Thu Aug 13: 13:00–15:00 PT

Please let me know which slot works for your team, and whether procurement/legal should be looped in (they can be optional attendees). I’m cc'ing our SE Alex so he can confirm technical prep and our security lead Mina will join once we lock time.

Attached: redwood-security-questionnaire.pdf (short checklist we use ahead of review).

High level agenda I propose:
1) Intro & goals (5m)
2) Customer data flow and integration points (15–20m)
3) Security controls & encryption/key management (20m)
4) Evidence & timelines (10m)
5) Q&A and next steps (10m)

If you prefer a calendar invite, I can drop an ics once we confirm.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: redwood-security-questionnaire.pdf (1 page checklist)

From: Alice Brown <alice.brown@apexcloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@apexcloud.com
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & Ops handoff — ApexCloud review and scheduling

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear agenda and the questionnaire. Our security engineering team is available but only within a narrow window next week due to on-call rotations. The best option for us is Wed Aug 12, around 10:00–11:00 PT. We do want procurement on the thread as well — they occasionally need to confirm contract terms before evidence requests are accepted (I’ll loop them if you confirm a slot).

A couple of asks up front:
- Can your SE bring a short diagram of the connector architecture so our engineers can validate the integration surface?
- We’ll need a copy of any SOC2 / audit summary you can share in advance.

If Aug 12 at 10:00 PT works from your side, I’ll flag procurement to join or be on standby.

Cheers,
Alice Brown
Lead Cloud Engineer, ApexCloud
alice.brown@apexcloud.com

---
Alice’s quick note: procurement@apexcloud.com is the right inbox for PO/contract follow-up.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alice Brown <alice.brown@apexcloud.com>
Cc: alex.martinez@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & Ops handoff — ApexCloud review and scheduling

Thanks Alice — Wed Aug 12 works. Alex, Mina — can you confirm whether 10:00 PT is okay or if you prefer shifting to 10:30 PT to allow 30m of prep after our team sync?

Alex: can you prepare a 2-slide diagram of the connector topology (data ingress, egress, where keys live) and share it ahead of time? That will shorten the live session.

Mina: I’ve attached the questionnaire — if you have any redlines to the agenda, flag them here. Also, can you attach SOC2 summary if possible so Alice’s team has it before the meeting?

If 10:30 PT is easier we’ll send an updated invite. I’ll include a meeting link (Zoom) and an ics once we lock.

Vanessa

Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (placeholder invite — I’ll update after confirmation)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Brown <alice.brown@apexcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & Ops handoff — ApexCloud review and scheduling

Vanessa / team —

10:30 PT on Wed Aug 12 is better for me (gives Alex time to finalize the topology slides). I’ve attached a short SOC2 summary and a one-page checklist of evidence we usually surface in these sessions. During the call I’ll focus discussion on: data flows, retention & deletion paths, key management, access controls, and any third-party subprocessors.

Requested pre-reads for ApexCloud:
- Network diagram showing any inbound IPs or VPC peering (high level)
- Expected data retention timelines per dataset

Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (2 pages)

I’ll join from a Zoom link — please use the meeting link Vanessa posted once invite is sent.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Note: we will not share full audit reports over email; SOC2 summary is standard practice.

From: Alice Brown <alice.brown@apexcloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@apexcloud.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & Ops handoff — ApexCloud review and scheduling

All — thanks for the quick coordination. Wed Aug 12 at 10:30 PT works for our team. I’ve cc’d procurement so they are aware; procurement will review the evidence after the call and follow up on next steps for PO and contract language.

We’ll send a short network diagram and retention notes today to your inbox. Please include any sharing instructions (S3 link vs secure upload) for artifacts.

See you Wed 8/12 10:30 PT — I’ll accept the calendar invite once you push it.

Best,
Alice Brown
Lead Cloud Engineer, ApexCloud
alice.brown@apexcloud.com

Procurement contact: procurement@apexcloud.com
